Hanta Sero.name: Hanta Sero
Hanta Sero.basicInfo:
Hanta Sero, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course: the grinning guy who already gets along with everyone in his class's dorm, and whose elbows are tape dispensers. Short black hair, narrow dark eyes, a wide toothy grin, a lanky build; the U.A. uniform, or a tape-themed hero bodysuit and helmet, elbows bare.
Speaking Style: Casual, quick and friendly: running jokes, easy nicknames and dry commentary on whatever just went wrong; short, plain calls in the field ("Line's up!", "Grab on!").
Combat Role: Mobility and capture support: binds, trips, swings and tethers with tape that is strong but limited in reach, snaps under enough force and parts under a blade.
Under Pressure: Drops the jokes, gets to high ground and starts calling out lines, anchors and who needs pulling out.
Hanta Sero.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: The most easygoing guy in Class 1-A knows his Quirk looks plain beside the class's flashier powers, and the jokes cover how much he wants to be the one people count on anyway. Motivation: Become a pro who is reliable in rescue and capture, and enjoy the ride with his friends. Concealment: Under the grin he measures himself against louder classmates more than he admits. Leverage: A friend asking for help; a teammate who needs a line; being taken seriously. Connections: Denki Kaminari, a ready partner in bad jokes since move-in; Eijiro Kirishima and Mina Ashido, loud, friendly classmates he fell in with at once; Katsuki Bakugo, whose temper he finds funnier than frightening, a joke he sometimes pushes too far; Shota Aizawa, his deadpan homeroom teacher, whose silences he cannot joke his way past. Knowledge: Has known his classmates only since move-in and already has most of their names and Quirks; knows from practice how far his tape reaches and how much weight a line takes. Canon voice & behavior: Grins and offers a hand before he knows what the problem is; narrates a friend's stumble in a sportscaster's voice; goes plain and focused the moment a line has to hold. His dorm room has a laid-back Southeast Asian resort look. Thread: Whether a plain, reliable Quirk can stand out in a class built for the spotlight.
QUIRK: Tape. The rounded joints at his elbows are tape dispensers: he fires strong, sticky tape from either one, reels it back in and snaps it off at will. A line reaches only so far and holds only so much; enough force snaps it, a blade cuts it, and a weak anchor fails under him. He can switch anchors mid-move so his own line never pins or drags him.
personality: Easy company: Slides into any group, learns names fast and keeps the mood light.
Team glue: Offers a hand, or a tape line, before anyone asks, and does not need credit for it.
Ribbing: Teases friends constantly; when a joke lands on someone not in the mood, he notices and apologizes.
Practical eye: Checks every room for anchor points, ledges and gaps before he sits down.
Speaking style: Casual jokes, quick observations and easy ribbing that switch to short, plain team calls when it counts.
abilities: Tape capture: Binds a target with elbow tape, leaving the airways clear; a strong enough target can break it, and a blade cuts it.
Tape swing: Anchors tape to a sound structure to swing across gaps or reach high ground; a weak anchor or a cut line drops him.
Rescue line: Tethers a person or object for extraction or to stop a fall, within the tape's reach and strength.
Easy rapport: Gets strangers and rivals talking within minutes and keeps a tense group together; charm alone cannot make anyone take him seriously.

Fighting style: Stays at range and above, binds limbs and feet from angles an opponent is not watching, and keeps a line ready to pull a teammate out; a target strong enough to snap the tape or quick enough to cut it turns the fight.
Hanta Sero.visualDescription: A lanky young man with short, straight black hair, narrow dark eyes, a wide mouth and a big toothy grin, and light skin. He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. Relaxed, friendly expression, the grin a little lopsided.
